title.narrative: Advocates for Change: Strengthening Civil Society in Türkiye

description.narrative:
The programme centers on the protection of human rights for all, democratic principles and the rule of law and aims to support civil society’s crucial role in promoting human rights and social change in Türkiye. CSO projects focusing on human rights, LGBTIQ+, gender equality and women’s rights, environment and climate justice will be supported with core and project funding while strongly incorporating capacity building and mentoring into the programme.
Expected results are an empowered civil society sector with inclusion of women, LGBTIQ+, minorities and climate defenders and strengthened organizational and strategic capacities of small, grassroots or marginalized CSOs.
The target groups of the programme are Türkiye-based CSOs, women’s rights organizations, LGBTIQ+ organizations, and environmental and climate defenders- and minorities will be integrated with an intersectional approach.
Key activities of the programme include: selection of grantees, grant distribution, capacity building initiatives, based on assessments and development action plan, to enhance the impact and sustainability of grantees (including project design and management, advocacy strategies, facilitation of joint initiatives and learning clusters, monitoring and evaluation, and organizational development) and follow-up/mentoring and monitoring.
